svg.title: Perennos DEMON MODE. Burn it before it resets.
svg.desc: A tachometer needle sweeps from Austere through Lean, Normal and Rich to DEMON as a countdown to the plan reset runs down, while the allowance left stays high. At the redline the horned face goes white-hot and heat shimmers off the right horn.
svg.text: PERENNOS · USE IT OR LOSE IT
